notes: Item 19 contains three sets of tables: (1) All Marble Slab Creamery Restaurants (MSC only + co-branded, n=195), (2) Co-branded Restaurants (MSC + Great American Cookies, n=120), and (3) Standalone MSC-only Restaurants (n=75). Each set includes Table 1 (Net Sales by location type), Table 2 (Range of Net Sales distribution), Table 3 (Food Cost % of Net Sales), and Table 4 (Labor Cost % of Net Sales). Table 2 Range of Net Sales records were not extracted as separate records because they represent distribution buckets rather than cohort-level average/median/min/max metrics; the key summary statistics are captured in the Table 1 records. The #/% column for Net Sales tables represents units meeting or exceeding average (>=Avg); for cost percentage tables it represents units at or below average (<=Avg). The data is unaudited and omits all operating costs except food/paper and labor. Reporting period is January 1 to December 31, 2024 for all three sets.
